lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct white vertical lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section with a slight increase in density toward the posterior torso.

lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Anterior lines 1, 2, and 3, and posterior lines 11 and 12, exhibit truncation before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron on the bridge of the muzzle; white patch on the throat; singular white spot on the lower cheek area.
